message.content: {"summary": "Address critical reliability and accessibility gaps in the ArtViewer and ArtScene components, focusing on cached image handling and focus management.", "verdict": "PROPOSE", "items": [{"issue": "Cached images may not trigger onLoad, causing transitions to hang.", "evidence": "src/art/ArtScene.tsx: { setLoaded(true); onReady?.() }} />", "change": "In ArtScene, add a useEffect that checks image.current.complete immediately after mount to call setLoaded(true) and onReady() if the image is already cached.", "check": "Verify that artworks transition immediately when served from browser cache."}, {"issue": "Dialog focus management is disruptive; autoFocus on 'Close' bypasses artwork content and controls.", "evidence": "src/art/ArtViewer.tsx: ", "change": "Remove autoFocus from the Close button. Implement a focus trap or ensure the initial focus is set to the dialog container or the first navigation control (Previous).", "check": "Confirm screen reader focus begins at the start of the dialog content rather than the Close button."}, {"issue": "Interval-based timing in ArtViewer is susceptible to jitter due to frequent dependency resets.", "evidence": "src/art/ArtViewer.tsx: setInterval(() => { ... }, 250) depends on [playing, paused, visible, failed, loaded, selected.id]", "change": "Refactor the 60-second rotation to use a single stable interval or requestAnimationFrame, calculating elapsed time based on a timestamp delta rather than a 250ms accumulator.", "check": "Verify that the 60-second rotation remains accurate regardless of state updates to 'visible' or 'loaded'."}]}
